workflows.title: Build the right checklist
workflows.note: The broker selects circumstances. Fixed rules generate the checklist; the broker ticks the required items and confirms.

steps.title: Broker opens request form
steps.action: Identify the existing loan, assigned broker, each applicant and their permitted recipients. Capture contact details without overwriting another applicant.
steps.guard: A contact can have multiple loans. Never infer a loan from an email alone.
steps.ghl: Internal form + loan context; context-safe mapping needs validation.

steps.title: Select the circumstances
steps.action: Select purchase/refinance/construction, property use, current construction stage, income evidence route and each debt’s treatment. Review self-employed eligibility before generating a tax pack; alternative routes never stack.
steps.guard: One consolidated card must not make every retained card a consolidation request.
steps.ghl: Conditional form fields; repeated applicant/account mapping to prove.

steps.title: Apply fixed scenario rules
steps.action: Home-loan refinance = 6 months. Consolidated credit card = 6 months. Retained credit card = 3 months. Apply other standards only after approval.
steps.guard: No broker period override or automatic lender waiver. No blanket request for all 70 items. Keep publication date, check date and channel on the rule.
steps.ghl: Rules evaluation; native feasibility to prove.

steps.title: Approved rule available?
steps.action: Continue with approved rules. If a selected item has no approved standard or falls outside the retained catalogue, flag it for controlled review.
steps.guard: Unknown is not zero and not a guessed maximum period.
steps.ghl: If/Else on evaluated result; rule source is to be selected.

steps.title: Review, tick and confirm
steps.action: Show the applicant, account, document, locked period and any exception. Broker ticks the required documents and submits.
steps.guard: Saving a draft sends nothing. Explicit confirmation is required.
steps.ghl: Broker form submission / reviewed request event.

steps.title: Resolve the rule exception
steps.action: Route missing standards or excluded documents to the broker/policy owner. Resolve through controlled rule maintenance or handle outside this collection module.
steps.guard: Do not silently reinstate removed financials, consents or expense documents.
steps.ghl: Internal task; no client issue while selected rule remains unresolved.

workflows.title: Issue one request set
workflows.note: Request records hold the truth. Tags summarise what the contact still needs to provide.

steps.title: Confirmed request arrives
steps.action: Receive the confirmed checklist with loan, applicants, account references and standard version.
steps.guard: One authoritative issue event; do not independently start on both form and every document tag.

steps.title: Already issued this revision?
steps.action: Check a durable issue guard using loan + checklist revision, scoped to the request set.
steps.guard: A retry must not duplicate requests, tasks or invitations.
steps.ghl: Durable guard storage and atomic issue processing require proof.

steps.title: Create document requests
steps.summary: One record per subject and requirement
steps.trigger: One record per subject and requirement
steps.action: Create selected requests with document key, applicant/entity/account, period, revision and status. Already-held evidence needs an explicit file link, matching subject/period and review state. Invite only for client-action items; accepted held evidence does not enter chasing.
steps.guard: Never overwrite another loan’s request or previous upload.
steps.ghl: Per-request storage design: native linked records if proven; otherwise adapter.

steps.title: Synchronise needed tags
steps.action: Invoke DC-07 after request persistence. It applies needed tags and the action-needed summary from current requests; this step must not become a second tag writer.
steps.guard: Tags are a projection; counts and periods live on requests.
steps.ghl: Add Contact Tag action after correct-contact projection.

steps.title: Send the upload invitation
steps.action: Send the approved invitation with the correct recipient’s loan-scoped upload link. Start one reminder sequence for this request set.
steps.guard: Respect allowed channel and DND. Do not send before requests persist; record delivery attempt to prevent repeat invite.
steps.ghl: Send Email / SMS. Private upload-link implementation to prove.

steps.title: No duplicate issue
steps.action: Use the existing issue result; do not recreate or resend.
steps.guard: A changed checklist is a new reviewed revision, not a replay.

workflows.title: Receive the selected document
workflows.note: Proposed: a saved submission marked ready for review pauses chasing that item. Receipt is separate from broker acceptance.

steps.title: Client opens upload link
steps.action: Authorise the recipient and show only their actionable loan-specific requests, including the relevant account and fixed period.
steps.guard: Do not edit global dropdown options. A bare email or loan reference is not access control.
steps.ghl: Private upload page + per-request dropdown filtering.

steps.title: Select request and upload
steps.summary: One or more files for this item
steps.trigger: One or more files for this item
steps.action: Client chooses the exact request and attaches files. A six-month requirement may be one combined PDF.
steps.guard: Selecting a dropdown item does not mark it received.
steps.ghl: File Upload field exists; dynamic scope/history and repeated submissions need proof.

steps.title: Files saved and linked?
steps.action: Validate the submission, recipient, request revision and durable file references. Deduplicate repeated upload events.
steps.guard: Never acknowledge a failed save or a mismatched request.

steps.title: Ready for broker review?
steps.action: Support multiple files and partial/ready submission. Statements and accepted transaction listings may combine to cover the dates. Overlapping files do not establish continuous coverage. Do not accept a file count as evidence.
steps.guard: No automatic financial-content acceptance. Client declaration only signals readiness for review.
steps.ghl: Submission state + broker review; partial-upload UX is proposed.

steps.title: Received · awaiting review
steps.action: Set Received awaiting review, keep receipt visible and create a broker review task. Ordinary chasing pauses for this request. Run DC-07 to reconcile tags.
steps.guard: Not Verified; do not advance the loan to lender-ready.
steps.ghl: Request state update + internal task; receipt pause needs owner sign-off.

steps.title: Keep request outstanding
steps.action: Show the upload error; allow retry against the correct request. Route unmatched submissions for staff handling.
steps.guard: No tag/status change on failure. No guess at the applicant.

steps.title: Keep partial evidence
steps.action: Preserve uploaded files and show the remaining requirement. Continue against this request without duplicating it.
steps.guard: Do not claim the required period is covered because a file exists.
steps.ghl: Partial state and request-level remaining text.

workflows.title: Chase only what is missing
workflows.note: Draft cadence: invitation, then 3 business days to email, 4 more to one permitted-channel reminder, 5 more to a broker task. Cap at two reminders. Calendar, timing and copy require approval before activation.

steps.title: One reminder sequence
steps.action: Ensure a single active reminder sequence per loan/request set. Reopened requests reuse the active sequence.
steps.guard: Do not run one uncoordinated campaign for each tag.
steps.ghl: Workflow entry with durable per-request-set guard.

steps.title: Wait for approved interval
steps.summary: Cadence is still to be decided
steps.trigger: Cadence is still to be decided
steps.action: Use the draft 3 / 4 / 5 business-day schedule only after approval. Respect recipient timezone, approved window and a proposed contact-level minimum 3-business-day gap across reminder/replacement sends. Receipt acknowledgements are events, not extra chases.
steps.guard: No production send until cadence, cap and copy are approved.
steps.ghl: Wait action supports timing/conditions; values pending.

steps.title: Safe to contact now?
steps.action: Recheck loan pause/closure, recent client replies, recipient permissions, DND, channel validity, last outreach and attempt cap immediately before sending. A client reply pauses the chase for broker handling; another case must not create overlapping outreach.
steps.guard: A pause while waiting must suppress the next send.

steps.title: Any current missing items?
steps.action: Read only Requested, Partially received or Replacement requested items for this loan and recipient.
steps.guard: Never reuse the original issued list after uploads.

steps.title: Send current outstanding list
steps.action: Compose approved email/SMS with current required items and period wording. Record send/attempt and wait again.
steps.guard: Final send must use a fresh revision; already queued external sends may not be cancellable.
steps.ghl: Send Email / SMS with generated current content.

steps.title: Pause or hand to broker
steps.action: Exit or suspend as appropriate; raise an owned task when human follow-up is required.
steps.guard: Opt-out is not cleared by resuming a loan.

steps.title: Stop client chase
steps.action: Stop this request set’s ordinary reminders. Route pending receipts to review; accepted requests may complete collection.
steps.guard: No client chase for Received awaiting review.

workflows.title: Accept or request a replacement
workflows.note: The broker checks the evidence. Collection complete is not lending approval or permission to lodge.

steps.title: Broker review task
steps.action: Show the document, requested period, applicant/account, submission revision and prior files.
steps.guard: The client-selected document type does not verify its content.
steps.ghl: Task / internal notification with secure evidence access.

steps.title: Broker’s decision
steps.action: Review subject/account, all pages, continuous coverage, financial year, finalisation status and TFN handling. Check freshness against its recorded reference event. Record reviewer, date and reason.
steps.guard: No automatic acceptance from file presence. Avoid applying a decision to a newer replacement upload.

steps.title: Accept this request
steps.action: Mark the request Accepted and preserve its history. Recompute request-set completion.
steps.guard: Acceptance applies only to this request revision. A later submission date or stage change triggers a broker freshness review, not a silent reset or borrower chase.

steps.title: Every selected request accepted?
steps.action: Check all active requests across the loan’s applicants and entities.
steps.guard: No missing request can be ignored just because its tag vanished.

steps.title: Collection complete
steps.action: Stop this loan’s collection chase and notify the broker that the selected collection pack is complete.
steps.guard: No auto lender approval, loan lodgement or settlement-stage movement.

steps.title: Request specific replacement
steps.action: Preserve old files. Reopen only the affected item with a clear reason; show it in the dropdown and current reminders.
steps.guard: No new duplicate request and no reset of other accepted evidence.
steps.tags: Needed tag restored if action remains

steps.title: Keep remaining work active
steps.summary: Missing or other review tasks remain
steps.trigger: Missing or other review tasks remain
steps.action: Leave other requests in their actual states. Chase only items still needing client action.
steps.guard: Received items remain with the broker, not in ordinary client chasing.

workflows.title: Pause, resume and close safely
workflows.note: Loan controls and contact channel controls are different. Neither should inadvertently stop an unrelated loan.

steps.title: Control event
steps.action: Receive an owned loan-control or checklist-amendment decision, client reply, or a channel permission/delivery event.
steps.guard: Identify exact loan and recipient before changing anything.

steps.title: Which control applies?
steps.action: Apply pause/closure/reply to the loan request set; apply channel restrictions to the actual recipient channel. Route reviewed checklist changes to the amendment action.
steps.guard: A summary paused tag alone must not suppress all loans.
steps.ghl: Request-set status plus native DND/channel checks.

steps.title: Pause or close this loan
steps.action: Set the loan request-set state and stop/suppress its reminders. Preserve every request and file.
steps.guard: Closing does not erase financial evidence or declare requests accepted.
steps.ghl: Scoped status/exit; multi-opportunity handling must be tested.

steps.title: Resume after recheck
steps.action: Read current requirements, permission and send cap; re-enter at most one reminder sequence if appropriate.
steps.guard: Do not resend the initial invitation or override DND.

steps.title: Suppress affected channel
steps.action: Respect DND and invalid channel state; notify broker when action is needed.
steps.guard: Do not infer permission for another channel.

steps.title: Amend the checklist
steps.action: Create a reviewed revision for stage, route or freshness changes. Add scoped requests or withdraw with owner/reason; preserve old evidence. Revalidate held files against changed dates/stage. Future-stage requirements carry no current needed tag. Notify only reviewed changes.
steps.guard: Do not reset reminder attempts, recreate accepted requests or silently change an issued period. Newly selected unapproved rules remain draft.
steps.ghl: Controlled amendment form/event → persisted revision → DC-07.

steps.title: Reconcile current summary
steps.action: Refresh display and summaries from current requests.
steps.guard: Keep another loan’s actionable requests intact.

workflows.title: Keep tags truthful
workflows.note: This is the only document-tag writer. It prevents one upload clearing a tag needed by another account, applicant or loan.

steps.title: Request state changed
steps.action: Reconcile after committed state changes; retry safely on transient failure.
steps.guard: Use current persisted data, not decrement counters from duplicate events.

steps.title: Read all relevant requests
steps.action: For each document key, find unresolved client-action requests belonging to this contact; include Requested, Partial and Replacement. Paused loan requests retain their needed-state evidence.
steps.guard: Accepted, received-for-review, waived or cancelled items do not create ordinary client-action need.
steps.ghl: Linked request query; a plain contact field is insufficient for concurrent loans.

steps.title: Same document still needed?
steps.action: Aggregate at contact + document type. Loan A received must not clear Loan B or card B.
steps.guard: An empty dropdown on one loan is not proof the contact needs nothing.

steps.title: Add or retain needed tag
steps.summary: One or more requests need action
steps.trigger: One or more requests need action
steps.action: Retain the canonical needed tag. No new tag for each account, month count or loan.
steps.guard: Period and account stay on the request, not inside tag names.

steps.title: Remove needed tag
steps.summary: No requests of that type need action
steps.trigger: No requests of that type need action
steps.action: Remove only this document type’s needed tag. Keep evidence and reviewer tasks.
steps.guard: Persist receipt first; remove tag only after successful all-request reconciliation.

steps.title: Refresh summaries
steps.action: Recompute summary tags and loan-specific checklist text; log reconciliation. Tag changes do not issue a new request set.
steps.guard: One writer; prevent tag-trigger feedback loops.

overview.title: From broker request to complete pack
overview.sub: One loan-specific checklist drives the whole journey
overview.note: Click a workflow to inspect its branches and build details. Dashed connectors are return/control paths. All automation is proposed, not live.

steps.title: Broker setup
steps.action: Open DC-01 to inspect the form and fixed scenario rules.
steps.guard: No broker period override.

steps.title: Issue requests & tags
steps.action: Open DC-02 for issue guards, request records and initial invitation.
steps.guard: One request set per loan revision.

steps.title: Client uploads
steps.action: Open DC-03 for failed, partial and complete submission branches.
steps.guard: Receipt is not acceptance.

steps.title: Broker review
steps.action: Open DC-05 for acceptance and replacement paths.
steps.guard: Only a broker verifies evidence.

steps.title: Collection complete
steps.action: Notify broker and stop this collection request set.
steps.guard: Not lender approval or automatic lodgement.

steps.title: Pause & controls
steps.action: Open DC-06 for pause, resume, closure and channel restrictions.
steps.guard: Do not suppress unrelated loans.

steps.title: Outstanding-only reminders
steps.action: Open DC-04 for the reminder loop, stop rules and unresolved cadence.
steps.guard: Recheck immediately before every send.

steps.title: Tag reconciliation
steps.action: Open DC-07 for exact tag removal and multi-account handling.
steps.guard: One upload cannot clear another request.
steps.ghl: Add/Remove Contact Tag after request query.

rules: Credit card consolidated into home loan
Applicable tax returns and retained financials
Current project versions; later-stage evidence later
fields: Person and communication permissions; needed tags are summaries.
Loan reference, broker, scenario, collection status
Each deal has its own collection lifecycle.
Revision, standard version, issue guard, pause state, reminder count
Preserve issued requirements and prevent duplicate entry.
Document key, applicant/entity/account, coverage, count, status
Authoritative checklist; exact native GHL storage must be proven.
Request/revision reference, file references, receipt time, deduplication key
Preserve upload history and match the exact request.
Reviewer, decision, reason, time and evidence revision
Acceptance is a human decision, not file presence.
gates: Prove concurrent loans, multiple applicants and multiple accounts without overwriting.
Prove private links, recipient-specific dropdowns, persistent files and repeat uploads.
Prove generated current lists, exact loan targeting and suppression before send.
Approve reminder cadence/cap/copy, remaining proposed periods, receipt pause and partial-upload behaviour.
